case_title: RAHMAN MABRA VS. NISSAN NORTH AMERICA, INC. ET AL

docket_entries.description: REMOVED FROM MASTER JURY CALENDAR SET FOR JUN-24-2024 - CASE SETTLED. ASSIGNED TO DEPT. 610 ON JAN-07-2025 AT 10:30 AM FOR DISMISSAL PER CRC 3.1385. REGINA LIOU, ESQ. APPEARING FOR PLAINTIFF OVER THE TELEPHONE. NO OTHER APPEARANCES ON THIS MATTER. THE COURT IMPOSES SANCTIONS TO PLAINTIFF'S LAW FIRM OF STRATEGIC LEGAL PRACTICES, APC (ATTORNEY TIONNA CARVALHO) IN THE AMOUNT OF $250.00, FOR FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH THE COURT'S ORDER PURSUANT TO THE NOTICE OF TIME AND PLACE OF TRIAL AND TRIAL ORDER AND FOR FAILURE TO APPEAR IN PERSON FOR TRIAL CALL TODAY AT 9:30AM. A NOTICE OF SETTLEMENT WAS FILED AT 9:05AM TODAY. PLAINTIFF'S EX PARTE APPLICATION TO CONTINUE TRIAL ON 6/21/24 WAS REJECTED FOR FILING, THEREFORE PARTIES WHO WERE PRESENT ON 6/21/24 AT THE 11:00AM EX PARTE HEARING WERE ORDERED TO APPEAR IN PERSON FOR TRIAL CALL. NO OSC WILL BE SET BY THE COURT AT THIS TIME. IF THE SANCTIONS IS NOT PAID ON 7/5/24, THE AMOUNT OF SANCTIONS WILL BE DOUBLE AND THE COURT WILL SET AN ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE. JUDGE: ANNE-CHRISTINE MASSULLO; CLERK: R. VELUZ; MATTER NOT REPORTED. (206)
